description: This C# source file defines the ActivationDataActivatorProvider class and its nested classes, which are responsible for producing grain context activators within the Orleans runtime. It contains logic to instantiate and retrieve grain activators based on grain type, including handling stateless worker activation contexts.

classes.name: ActivationDataActivatorProvider
classes.description: Provides activators for grain contexts, either stateful or stateless, based on grain type and configuration.

classes.name: ActivationDataActivator
classes.description: Nested class responsible for creating and managing individual grain activation contexts, including instantiation and error handling.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerActivator
classes.description: Activator that wraps another activator to handle stateless worker grain contexts.

methods.name: ActivationDataActivatorProvider.TryGet
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve or create a grain context activator based on the grain type, considering placement strategies.

methods.name: ActivationDataActivator.CreateContext
methods.description: Creates a new grain context, including grain instance instantiation and setting up execution context.

methods.name: StatelessWorkerActivator.CreateContext
methods.description: Creates a context for a stateless worker grain, wrapping another activator.
